UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores a student's personalized finance learning path, gamified progress, spaced repetition stats, offline saved tutorial IDs, and study reminder preferences.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

displayName.description: Student display name for progress and community attribution.

xp.description: Total experience points earned from flashcards and quizzes.

cardsMastered.description: Count of flashcards reaching SM-2 mastery interval.

completedNodeIds.description: Bounded list of completed curriculum ladder node IDs (max 50).

savedTutorialIds.description: Bounded list of tutorial IDs saved for offline study (max 50).

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily study notifications are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was last synced.

ForumPost.title: ForumPost
ForumPost.description: A peer-support study question or literal concept explanation shared in the student community forum.

authorId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the student who created the post.

authorName.description: Display name of the student author.

body.description: Question details or apples-to-apples peer explanation.

conceptTag.description: Specific curriculum concept tag (e.g., Prime Cost, Balance Sheet).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the post was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private student study profile and cloud backup document owned strictly by {userId}.

/forumPosts/{postId}.description: Peer support community forum posts accessible to authenticated learners.
